targets.rawSql: SELECT page, metric, count() AS samples, round(quantile(0.50)(value_ms),2) AS p50_ms, round(quantile(0.95)(value_ms),2) AS p95_ms FROM agent.portal_gui_perf WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM agent.portal_gui_perf ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) AND outcome = 'pass' GROUP BY page, metric ORDER BY page, metric

panels.title: Slowest gRPC (server-side) this run — with trace_id

targets.rawSql: SELECT rpc_method, round(max(value_ms),2) AS worst_ms, argMax(trace_id, value_ms) AS trace FROM agent.portal_gui_perf WHERE run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM agent.portal_gui_perf ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1) AND metric = 'grpc_server_ms' AND rpc_method != '' GROUP BY rpc_method ORDER BY worst_ms DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: main branch — grpc_server_ms p95 trend by rpc_method

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfHour(ts) AS time, rpc_method, round(quantile(0.95)(value_ms),2) AS p95_ms FROM agent.portal_gui_perf WHERE branch = 'main' AND metric = 'grpc_server_ms' AND rpc_method != '' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY time, rpc_method ORDER BY time
